about: The one pointer to the model of the robot as it is now. Every simulator, rehearsal, video and new training task loads this variant unless it states a historical model on purpose. Change it in the same commit that adds a newer dated variant, and update the robotics checkout's CURRENT-STATE.json fact battery_sim_model_20261104 (or its successor) to the same manifest hash.
describes: battery backpack (V1.40 frame, V1.41 cap and hatch, battery on the cap), A7Z on the orange V1.35 roof saddle without lid, U20CAM head with microphones and touch board; charger box removed

historical.asbuilt: 2026-10-15 bench box, Pi Zero W head
historical.plugged: charger pack on the bench supply (A7Z saddle drawn white, rear converter box); retired 2026-11-03
historical.battery: 2026-10-15 battery backpack plan, superseded by battery-20261104
